meaning: 'verified' means an independent reader attested every item against the source. It does not upgrade any compliance claim, and the script cannot prove the reader's independence - it records the attestation.

verifier.statement: I extracted all 9 pages of ohchr-udhr-spanish.pdf with pdftotext (UTF-8), read the accessible HTML in full, compared every heading, paragraph, list, and page attribution, and confirmed the normalized full texts are word-for-word identical (1927 words each) including accents and punctuation.
